request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe: Open API Layer for Cardano's dApp Protocols over 12 months.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is intended to provide a single open standardized interface so developers and AI agents can discover, integrate, and compose Cardano on-chain protocols through a consistent surface.
The proposal states that Tx3 produces documentation, auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from verified protocol interface definitions.
Through Catalyst Fund 14, TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry at tx3.land.
The proposal says it will fund 12 additional protocol onboardings, 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposal claims Cardano currently lacks a common interface mechanism across the ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and making cross-protocol composability impractical.

The proposal claims it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal states the requested amount did not, at the time of submission, on its own or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, and also received Intersect 2025 open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC that is being delivered on schedule.

The proposal states Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with TRSC and PSSC structures, external oversight entities, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month Tx3 project led by TxPipe and submitted by Intersect, focused on standardized Cardano protocol interfaces, agent-facing infrastructure, and 12 additional protocol onboardings, with several governance and oversight claims tied to Intersect budget process references and treasury smart contract administration.
